data.name: Immersive Companion Injuries (Beta)
data.shortDescription: Provides a more immersive injury and healing system to companions.
data.description:
I always found it very immersion breaking how Kelvin and Virginia can be healed from a potentially life threatening injury by just holding E for a short time. This mod addresses that by making there be genuine consequences for your companion getting injured and providing an immersive solution to healing them.

### What this mod does

Whenever Kelvin or Virginia fall into an injured state they must be brought to a bed and set to rest for 1 real time hour(customizable). They no longer heal and revive on their own. After sleeping for 1 hour they will awake at full health.

You also have the option of assigning permadeath to Kelvin or Virginia if you don't do it in a certain time in mod configs. THIS IS OFF BY DEFAULT.

### How to bring Kelvin and/or Virginia to a bed.

There is a new icon that appears on Kelvin and Virginia in an injured state. Hold E to pick them up and Control Y to drop them in the nearest beds. When you are close enough you will get a notification and a green light indicating you can place them on the bed. Double beds can hold 2 companion npcs. You can also press Control U to set down Kelvin and Virgina anywhere. They will remain in their injured state. If you don't like these keybinds it can be changed in mod configs.

### Does this work with multiple Kelvin's and Virginia's

Yes.

### What happens if the bed Kelvin and/or Virginia is on gets destroyed or moved?

They will fall to the ground. However there is a known bug that if Kelvin or Virginia are on a bed and it gets destroyed, any other companion npcs cannot be properly placed in bed. Restart the game if this happens.

### Can Kelvin and Virginia be hurt while in bed?

No.

### Editing Health

You can edit health in the mod configs if you think they are too weak.

### Multiplayer

Only works as the host in multiplayer right now.

https://youtu.be/b0EtHwrG7RY

If you want to see a video on how this mod works, look here.
